descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S25 「现成的 spec：床旁记事本能全屏打开，高度够回读一段口述，两种模式」 Existing specs: the encounter notepad opens full screen and is tall enough to read a dictation back, both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 The encounter notepad renders full-size, matching Vikram's app.（TFA-92592 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-14 step 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's chromium specs

When Run the three specs by title

Then The Hospital and Nursing Home encounter notepads open full screen and close with the text kept, and the Hospital notepad has at least 12 rows and is at least 260 px tall

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright verdicts. 'Matching Vikram's app' is a side-by-side look with the prototype, recorded by a human with the S22 screenshots

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
